source_definition_en: A specified point or extent in a reference space.
proposed_target_definition_en: A specified point or extent in a reference space.
layer_1_reason: The selected notion of location is a reference-space position. A sound source or touched object can be localized conditionally, not as essential auditory/tactile components; own-body proprioception is not inherent to external map location.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Social position or status is a separate conceptual extension, not a Social score for map location.

source_definition_en: The region enclosed by a reference entity.
proposed_target_definition_en: The region enclosed by a reference entity.
layer_1_reason: An enclosed region is predominantly visual; touching a boundary, exploring by movement, and egocentric position can directly but conditionally instantiate interiority. Audible contents are incidental.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Organizational insiders and psychological interiority extend CONTAINER but are not scored.

source_definition_en: A line delimiting the extent of an area.
proposed_target_definition_en: A line delimiting the extent of an area.
layer_1_reason: A line marking a physical area's limit does not inherently encode social norms; tactile border detection is conditional on a material boundary.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Interpersonal boundaries are a BOUNDARY-schema extension excluded from this physical score.

source_definition_en: A central point fixed by the limits of a reference figure.
proposed_target_definition_en: A central point fixed by the limits of a reference figure.
layer_1_reason: The geometrical center is defined relative to figure limits; touch can aid a tactile diagram or physical object conditionally but is not central in the specified sense.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Centers of attention, power and authority are separate abstract extensions.

source_definition_en: The part of an entity facing a specified observer or direction.
proposed_target_definition_en: The part of an entity facing a specified observer or direction.
layer_1_reason: The physical front side is determined by a referent's facing direction. Sound produced near the front is incidental; touching a physical front surface can help conditionally.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Front-line social status or leading position are not part of this entity-part sense.

source_definition_en: A region on the left of a reference entity under a specified viewpoint
proposed_target_definition_en: A region on the left of a reference entity under a specified viewpoint
layer_1_reason: 'Left side' is a reference-frame relation, not an intrinsically auditory or tactile property. Touch can locate a physical left panel conditionally; egocentric laterality can help establish viewpoint.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Left in ideological or political discourse is a distinct sense, not counted as Social.

source_definition_en: The degree to which a surface inclines relative to horizontal.
proposed_target_definition_en: The degree to which a surface inclines relative to horizontal.
layer_1_reason: Slope angle is visually available; a hand or foot can conditionally feel incline, and upright body orientation helps in embodied terrain contexts. Tactile input is not universally central to numerical slope.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: A figurative steep learning curve is a separate nonspatial extension.

source_definition_en: North of a mountain or south of a river under a traditional geographic convention.
proposed_target_definition_en: North of a mountain or south of a river under a traditional geographic convention.
layer_1_reason: The north/south landscape side can be located visually, but assigning the conventional geographic yin name depends on learned traditional terminology. Body posture does not determine cardinal geographic naming.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Philosophical or symbolic yin is a distinct extension; its symbolic attributes are excluded.

source_definition_en: South of a mountain or north of a river under a traditional geographic convention.
proposed_target_definition_en: South of a mountain or north of a river under a traditional geographic convention.
layer_1_reason: The south/north landscape side is visually locatable, but the conventional geographic yang label requires learned traditional terminology. Proprioception is not geographic orientation.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Philosophical or symbolic yang is a separate extension and excluded from scores.

source_definition_en: The measurable interval between two places.
proposed_target_definition_en: The measurable interval between two places.
layer_1_reason: A measurable interval between places has no intrinsic social relation. Auditory cues such as sound attenuation can conditionally support estimating the location of a sound emitter.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Emotional distance between people extends physical distance metaphorically and does not count as Social.

source_definition_en: A route along which motion could occur.
proposed_target_definition_en: A route along which motion could occur.
layer_1_reason: A spatial route is visible whether or not traveled; walking/tracing it and body orientation can conditionally instantiate the path, without making the noun an action.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Career and life paths map physical routes onto abstract development, not scored.

source_definition_en: A tangent relation where surfaces meet at a point or line without crossing.
proposed_target_definition_en: A tangent relation where surfaces meet at a point or line without crossing.
layer_1_reason: This narrowly defined geometrical point/line tangency can be inspected visually; physical touch is only a conditional material instantiation. Proprioception and social interaction are not part of the tangent relation.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Human social contact and communication are different senses; geometry/tangency wording also needs independent Chinese lexical verification.

source_definition_en: To bear an object's load so that it does not fall.
proposed_target_definition_en: To bear an object's load so that it does not fall.
layer_1_reason: The supporting bracket in the constructed example bears a load without active bodily movement or proprioception. Touch/pressure characterizes material support; motor contribution is conditional on active support by an agent.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Social support and emotional help are extended senses and do not enter this physical loading vector.

source_definition_en: The place or region occupied by an entity in a reference space.
proposed_target_definition_en: The place or region occupied by an entity in a reference space.
layer_1_reason: Like 位置, the target sense identifies an entity's position in reference space. Hearing or touching its source can sometimes help locate it, but they are not defining; own-body sensation is unnecessary for mapped locations.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Institutional/social location is a different extension from the physical place sense.

source_definition_en: A short distance between entities relative to a specified scale.
proposed_target_definition_en: A short distance between entities relative to a specified scale.
layer_1_reason: Proximity denotes a short static spatial separation, not the act of approaching. Travel over a short distance can conditionally instantiate it; group intimacy is not part of the physical relation.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Social or emotional closeness is a distinct proximity metaphor, not a scored social property.

source_definition_en: The measurable separation between two locations.
proposed_target_definition_en: The measurable separation between two locations.
layer_1_reason: Measurable spatial distance does not entail interpersonal relations; hearing can conditionally aid distance estimation when the referent is acoustic.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Emotional distance or social distancing is an extended sense excluded from the spatial score.

source_definition_en: The arrangement of entities along a common line or direction.
proposed_target_definition_en: The arrangement of entities along a common line or direction.
layer_1_reason: Alignment here is a static geometric arrangement along a common line. Touch may conditionally reveal material alignment, but actively arranging objects belongs to the event 'align', not the noun's target relation.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Alignment of opinions or political alliances is a social/conceptual extension excluded here.

source_definition_en: The amount of turn between intersecting lines or planes.
proposed_target_definition_en: The amount of turn between intersecting lines or planes.
layer_1_reason: The intersection angle is a geometric relation between lines/planes. Physical intersecting edges can be felt in some situations; body orientation is not inherent to the stated external geometry.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: A different angle on a problem is a perspectival metaphor and not the physical angle.

source_definition_en: The spatial interval keeping two entities apart.
proposed_target_definition_en: The spatial interval keeping two entities apart.
layer_1_reason: The specified sense is a static spatial interval keeping two entities apart; moving objects apart is the event 'separate', and relationships between people are not entailed.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Social separation or interpersonal estrangement is a distinct extended reading.

source_definition_en: The spatial arrangement of a body and its limbs.
proposed_target_definition_en: The spatial arrangement of a body and its limbs.
layer_1_reason: Posture denotes a body's limb configuration. Controlling/enacting a posture and joint-position/proprioceptive feedback directly realize this bodily arrangement, including robotic joint-state analogues; the selected example is a robot.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Political posturing or taking a stance extends body configuration to social expression, not scored.

source_definition_en: A route connecting positions through space.
proposed_target_definition_en: A route connecting positions through space.
layer_1_reason: The physical path exists without motion, but actively following it and egocentric body orientation can conditionally ground its traversable structure; this is consistent with the parallel Chinese route noun.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: A life path or path to success is an abstract trajectory extension.

source_definition_en: A state in which two physical surfaces meet.
proposed_target_definition_en: A state in which two physical surfaces meet.
layer_1_reason: Two physical surfaces touching are directly visual/tactile, but arbitrary material surfaces need not involve human body position or a social relationship.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Social contact, keeping in touch or networking are distinct extensions of the surface-contact relation.

source_definition_en: A state of bodily or mechanical stability under competing forces.
proposed_target_definition_en: The ability to maintain an upright bodily position without falling.
layer_1_reason: The prior definition mixed bodily and mechanical equilibrium, but the climber example is specifically bodily balance. Upright postural control and proprioception are direct; touch/visual cues are secondary. A narrower target sense invalidates automatic reuse of the previous reported taxonomy path.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Balance of power, work-life balance, and mechanical equilibrium are separate senses, not included in the revised bodily score.

source_definition_en: To bear a load or counter a force that would displace an entity.
proposed_target_definition_en: To bear a load or counter a force that would displace an entity.
layer_1_reason: This broad load-bearing verb includes a column supporting a roof without bodily proprioception or voluntary action. Physical contact/pressure is central; active motion is possible only in agent-support contexts.
layer_2_extension_not_scored: Moral, social, or emotional support is an extended sense, not counted.
